本回報與回覆是公開的，其他人可能閱讀或複製。請勿提交出生日期、出生時間、出生城市、私人紀錄、聯絡電話或含敏感資訊的截圖。請使用虛構測試資料重現問題。

This report and its replies are public and may be read or copied by others. Do not submit birth dates, birth times, birth cities, private records, contact phone numbers or screenshots containing sensitive information. Reproduce problems with fictional test data.

App 不會自動傳送手機內的資料。提交回報需要 GitHub 帳號；GitHub 依其隱私政策處理你提供的內容。我們無法承諾刪除 GitHub 或其他人保存、複製、快取的資料。

The app does not automatically send data from your phone. Submitting a report requires a GitHub account; GitHub handles the content you provide under its privacy policy. We cannot promise to delete information retained, copied or cached by GitHub or other people.

請描述問題及預期結果，不要提供私人資料。Describe the problem and expected result without private information.
